name: Universal
description: A flexible starter template for clear image prompts across everyday subjects and styles.

subject.label: Subject
subject.instruction: Describe the main subject, its defining traits, and the intended focal point.

scene.label: Scene
scene.instruction: Describe the setting, surrounding context, and the subject's relationship to the environment.

composition.label: Composition
composition.instruction: Define framing, camera angle, crop, depth, and visual hierarchy.

lighting.label: Lighting
lighting.instruction: Describe light direction, contrast, mood, color temperature, and shadows.

style.label: Style
style.instruction: Specify the visual style, medium, finish, and overall aesthetic language.

details.label: Details
details.instruction: Add important materials, textures, small features, atmosphere, and quality cues.

constraints.label: Constraints
constraints.instruction: State strict requirements, exclusions, readability needs, and artifact controls.

template_system_prompt: Return only valid JSON for the requested blocks. Build a concise, direct English image prompt with concrete visual details and no extra commentary.

name: Cinematic
description: Film-still prompts focused on dramatic framing, lens language, lighting, and mood.

subject.label: Subject
subject.instruction: Describe the actor, object, or main action with film-scene specificity.

scene.label: Scene
scene.instruction: Describe the location, time, atmosphere, and narrative context.

shot.label: Shot
shot.instruction: Specify shot size, lens feel, camera height, movement, and depth of field.

lighting.label: Lighting
lighting.instruction: Describe motivated light sources, contrast, rim light, practicals, haze, and shadow shape.

color_grade.label: Color Grade
color_grade.instruction: Define palette, film stock feel, saturation, contrast curve, and grade mood.

details.label: Details
details.instruction: Add production design, costume, texture, weather, and cinematic realism cues.

constraints.label: Constraints
constraints.instruction: State what must remain believable, coherent, and free of visual artifacts.

template_system_prompt: Return only valid JSON for the requested blocks. Write in the language of cinema: framing, lens, lighting, color grade, and production detail.

name: Photorealism
description: Realistic image prompts with camera, lens, material, and natural-light specificity.

subject.label: Subject
subject.instruction: Describe the real-world subject, scale, pose, condition, and key identifying details.

environment.label: Environment
environment.instruction: Describe the location, background, weather, surfaces, and believable context.

camera.label: Camera
camera.instruction: Specify camera viewpoint, lens length, aperture feel, focus, and natural perspective.

lighting.label: Lighting
lighting.instruction: Describe realistic light sources, exposure, shadow softness, reflections, and time of day.

materials.label: Materials
materials.instruction: Describe true-to-life textures, surface wear, fabric, skin, glass, metal, or organic detail.

details.label: Details
details.instruction: Add photographic quality cues such as micro-contrast, accurate scale, and plausible imperfections.

constraints.label: Constraints
constraints.instruction: State realism requirements and exclude stylization, impossible anatomy, distortion, and fake text.

template_system_prompt: Return only valid JSON for the requested blocks. Prioritize physically plausible detail, natural perspective, and real photographic language.

name: Art / Illustration
description: Illustrative prompts for stylized artwork, visual development, posters, and editorial art.

subject.label: Subject
subject.instruction: Describe the illustrated subject, silhouette, pose, expression, and key motifs.

concept.label: Concept
concept.instruction: Describe the idea, story, symbolism, or emotional direction behind the artwork.

composition.label: Composition
composition.instruction: Define layout, focal path, shape language, balance, negative space, and scale.

medium.label: Medium
medium.instruction: Specify medium and finish, such as gouache, ink, vector, concept art, or painterly digital.

palette.label: Palette
palette.instruction: Define color palette, contrast strategy, edge treatment, and graphic mood.

details.label: Details
details.instruction: Add pattern, texture, brushwork, line quality, ornament, and rendering priorities.

constraints.label: Constraints
constraints.instruction: State style consistency, clean edges, coherent anatomy, and artifact exclusions.

template_system_prompt: Return only valid JSON for the requested blocks. Shape the result as an art-directable illustration prompt with clear medium, composition, and palette choices.

name: Character
description: Character-focused prompts for portraits, full-body designs, costumes, and personality cues.

identity.label: Identity
identity.instruction: Describe the character archetype, role, personality, age impression, and emotional tone.

appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.instruction: Describe face, hair, body language, distinguishing features, and proportions.

pose.label: Pose
pose.instruction: Specify pose, gesture, expression, gaze direction, and interaction with props.

wardrobe.label: Wardrobe
wardrobe.instruction: Describe clothing, accessories, materials, color accents, and practical design logic.

environment.label: Environment
environment.instruction: Describe the background or context that supports the character without stealing focus.

style.label: Style
style.instruction: Specify rendering style, genre, lighting approach, and finish.

constraints.label: Constraints
constraints.instruction: State requirements for coherent anatomy, hands, facial symmetry, readable costume, and clean rendering.

template_system_prompt: Return only valid JSON for the requested blocks. Focus on a coherent character concept with readable design, personality, pose, and production-ready visual detail.

name: Scenes / Environment
description: Environment prompts for landscapes, interiors, worldbuilding, establishing shots, and mood studies.

location.label: Location
location.instruction: Describe the place, scale, geography, purpose, and main environmental focal point.

time_weather.label: Time / Weather
time_weather.instruction: Specify time of day, season, weather, visibility, and natural light conditions.

composition.label: Composition
composition.instruction: Define viewpoint, foreground, midground, background, leading lines, and sense of depth.

architecture_nature.label: Architecture / Nature
architecture_nature.instruction: Describe structures, terrain, vegetation, water, roads, objects, or environmental systems.

atmosphere.label: Atmosphere
atmosphere.instruction: Describe mood, color, haze, movement, sound-implied cues, and emotional temperature.

details.label: Details
details.instruction: Add small environmental marks, material textures, inhabitants, signs of use, and scale cues.

constraints.label: Constraints
constraints.instruction: State requirements for believable perspective, coherent geography, and no distracting artifacts.

template_system_prompt: Return only valid JSON for the requested blocks. Build a spatially coherent environment prompt with strong depth, atmosphere, and readable worldbuilding.

name: Text In Image
description: Graphic layouts with readable in-image text for posters, ads, covers, and social visuals.

headline.label: Headline
headline.instruction: Write the exact main on-image headline text; keep it short, readable, and intentional.

subheadline.label: Subheadline
subheadline.instruction: Write the exact supporting on-image text with fewer than 12 words unless the user asks otherwise.

cta.label: CTA
cta.instruction: Write the exact call-to-action text as a compact button, label, sticker, or footer phrase.

layout.label: Layout
layout.instruction: Describe text placement, image placement, hierarchy, alignment, spacing, and safe margins.

style.label: Style
style.instruction: Describe visual style, typography direction, brand tone, palette, and graphic treatment.

details.label: Details
details.instruction: Describe clarity, legibility, render quality, contrast, texture, and production finish.

constraints.label: Constraints
constraints.instruction: State strict requirements such as exact spelling, no extra letters, no watermark, clean typography, and readable text.

template_system_prompt: Return only valid JSON for the requested blocks. Keep all on-image text exact, concise, readable, and aligned with the specified layout; do not add unrequested words.
